name: blob_to_unreal
summary: 5-pass orchestrator that escorts a morph.engine Loom card's canvas snapshot out of the browser, through Hunyuan i2v, MediaPipe pose extraction, mocap_rig_anchor verification, and into Unreal Engine 5 via LiveLink UDP. Each pass crystal-anchored; UDP dry-run unless MSPC_UNREAL_LIVE=1. Synthetic fallbacks for Hunyuan + MediaPipe so the chain runs end-to-end without those installed.
passes_5: 2. image_to_video — Hunyuan i2v enqueue (or stub) → video.mp4
3. video_to_pose — MediaPipe Holistic (or synthetic from PNG hash) → pose.jsonl
4. pose_to_animation — verify_alignment per frame → rolled animation_crystal
5. unreal_live_link — UDP stream MocapFrames at fps → UE5 LiveLink Subject
cc_dispatchers: cc unreal-live-link send <pose.jsonl> [--host X --port N --fps N]

ue5_side: enable plugin Live Link + Live Link Skeletal Animation
open Live Link panel; subject auto-appears when stream starts
operator_setup.live_path: set MSPC_UNREAL_LIVE=1 in env to actually send UDP packets
